name: Adventurer
blurb: No banner, no order, just grit and a willingness to go first. The guild starts here.

roleDescriptions.melee: No banner, no order, just grit, a borrowed blade, and a willingness to stand where the steel meets.
roleDescriptions.ranged: Reads the land like a second language, then picks fights from a distance no one saw coming.
roleDescriptions.caster: Magic pieced together from half-remembered lessons and whatever actually worked, cast with more nerve than training.

name: Knight
blurb: Sworn, drilled, and reliable in a way freelancers rarely are. Cheap for what it brings.

roleDescriptions.melee: Sworn to an order, drilled since childhood, and first through the door every time, shield raised before the fear catches up.
roleDescriptions.ranged: Trades the shield wall for a crossbow, discipline unshaken, aim as steady as any oath.
roleDescriptions.caster: Etches battle-runes into steel rather than trusting open air, magic bound to armor like a second vow.

name: Dwarf Warrior
blurb: A wall with an axe. Almost impossible to put down, in no particular hurry.

roleDescriptions.melee: A wall of scarred stone and stubbornness, axe in hand, in absolutely no hurry to move for anything living.
roleDescriptions.ranged: Throws whatever's heavy enough to matter rather than carry it all the way into melee.
roleDescriptions.caster: Magic hammered, not spoken, forge-song and rune-carved stone in the old dwarven way.

name: Gladiator
blurb: Sword, net, and a bow for the ones that run. Fast and greedy for spoils.

roleDescriptions.melee: Sword and net, arena-bred, built for a fight the crowd remembers because it ended in one exchange.
roleDescriptions.ranged: Bow in hand and a showman's grin for the ones smart enough to run.
roleDescriptions.caster: Arena tricks dressed up with whatever charm coin could buy, half showmanship, half genuine spellcraft.

name: Samurai
blurb: One clean strike. Prizes a perfect kill and the rare blade it earns.

roleDescriptions.melee: Trained for one clean strike, a single breath of stillness before the blade, prizing the perfect kill over the messy one.
roleDescriptions.ranged: Trades the blade for a bow, the same unbroken patience behind the string.
roleDescriptions.caster: Wards and rites learned alongside the sword, not instead of it, prayer and steel drawn in the same breath.

name: Witch
blurb: Hexes, bargains, and a nose for what a ruin is really worth. Fragile.

roleDescriptions.melee: A blade wrapped in a whispered curse, kept close for when the hex alone isn't fast enough.
roleDescriptions.ranged: Flings hexbolts from a safe distance, wary of a body this easily broken.
roleDescriptions.caster: Hexes bent toward guarding as often as harming, binding wards and bargained protection struck in the dark.

name: Lizardman
blurb: Scales, claws, and a swamp-born refusal to die. Little sense for coin.

roleDescriptions.melee: Scales, claws, and a swamp-born refusal to die, patient as the mud that raised it.
roleDescriptions.ranged: Hunts from range the patient way its swamp taught it, still as reeds until the strike.
roleDescriptions.caster: Old swamp magic, murky and older by far than the guild that hired it.

name: Pyromancer
blurb: Answers every problem with fire. Devastating, and made of paper.

roleDescriptions.melee: A blade kept burning, for when fire alone won't close the distance fast enough.
roleDescriptions.ranged: Flings raw firebolts at range, blunt and immediate, no finesse required.
roleDescriptions.caster: Wreathes allies in guardian embers and blinding cinder-clouds as readily as it burns the enemy down.

name: Wizard
blurb: Decades of study in a pointed hat. Unmatched on anything arcane.

roleDescriptions.melee: A blade steadied by decades of study it never expected to need, arcane theory over a sword grip.
roleDescriptions.ranged: Trades ritual for reflex, hurling raw arcane bolts wherever the staff used to point.
roleDescriptions.caster: Decades of study spent as much on arcane barriers to shield allies as on unleashing the arcane itself.
